answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 9594 Country: India Title: Mufti Sahab, Assalam Alekum First of all sorry for asking too many Question within a week. Mufti Sahab I want to ask you that in tablighi Jamaat everybody is telling that 'Jo Raee ke dane ke baraabar bhi Imaan leke jayega usko Allah paak Duniya se 10 guni badi jannat dega.' Mufti sahab every body in jamaat who is old or new use this hadith, but i think 99% people dont know the quantity of 'Raee ke dane ke baraabar Imaan kitna hota hai'. Even I dont know. I want to know that either Imaam Gajhali or Mullah Ali Qari has explained this hadith i.e. 'How will that person who will have Raee ke dane ke baraabar imaan'. In Fatwa Id 9421 as I told One of my friend Dr. Warsi (done PHD in Fiqa from Al-Azahar Egypt). He is Mureed of Imaam Ghajali R.A. He told me that Imaam Ghajali has explained this in his book. I asked this to one Mufit has also but he told that he has only 1 book of Imaam Ghajali Question: Mufti Sahab, Assalam Alekum First of all sorry for asking too many Question within a week. Mufti sahab every body in jamaat who is old or new use this hadith, but i think 99% people dont know the quantity of 'Raee ke dane ke baraabar Imaan kitna hota hai'. Even I dont know. I want to know that either Imaam Gajhali or Mullah Ali Qari has explained this hadith i.e. 'How will that person who will have Raee ke dane ke baraabar imaan'. In Fatwa Id 9421 as I told One of my friend Dr. Warsi (done PHD in Fiqa from Al-Azahar Egypt). He is Mureed of Imaam Ghajali R.A. He told me that Imaam Ghajali has explained this in his book. I asked this to one Mufit has also but he told that he has only 1 book of Imaam Ghajali Answer ID: 9594 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2288/2083=D/1429) It is mentioned in the Hadith of Shafaat (intercession): فأخرج من كان في قلبه مثقال ذرة أو خردلة من إيمان (مشكاة 489) (So, O Prophet! Take out (from Jahannam ) those who have iman in their hearts even equal to a particle or a seed of mustard) Iman is the name of yaqeen (belief) which is not small or big. So, the words (in Hadith) zarrah or khardala mean the quality of yaqeen and its effects. If these effects are present in his heart even equal to seed of mustard, Allah Almighty will forgive him also on the intercession of the Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ). As far as the matter of Jannah ten times bigger is concerned, every person in paradise will not have less than it, since the last person going to the Paradise has been promised to be given a Paradise ten times bigger than this world. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
